name: Happy for Men
desc: Lime, mandarin and lemon bring a clean citrus snap, with freesia, jasmine and sea notes beneath. Cypress, musk and cedarwood settle the base.

name: 1872 for Women
desc: A bright mix of lemon, pineapple, mandarin and blueberry opens it, followed by rose, freesia, orchid and jasmine. Sandalwood, patchouli, musk and oakmoss close it soft and woody.

name: 1872 Masculine
desc: Rosemary, pepper, nutmeg and citrus open aromatic and spicy, with freesia, clary sage and jasmine in the heart. Cedarwood, sandalwood, patchouli and resins give a dry, warm base.

name: 20 Iconic Masculine
desc: Built on petitgrain, mandarin and yuzu, bright and slightly bitter, with pink pepper and rosemary adding a herbal spice. Cedarwood gives the finish a clean, dry backbone.

name: Blonde Amber
desc: Bergamot, bitter orange, rum and ginger open warm and boozy, then iris, jasmine, tuberose and saffron deepen the heart. Labdanum, vanilla, tonka bean and myrrh make a golden, resinous base.

name: C Woody Leather
desc: Mandarin opens briefly before tobacco and saffron bring a warm, smoky spice. Leather and oud close it, dark and dry, with a woody depth that lingers quietly.

name: Crab Apple Blossom
desc: Apple blossom opens crisp and green, and rhubarb and mint keep the heart cool and tart. A touch of sugar softens it, while sandalwood gives the base a creamy, quiet finish.

name: Jump Up and Kiss Me Hedonistic
desc: Bergamot, grapefruit and neroli open sparkling, with cherry, maté and clary sage in a green, juicy heart. Amber, leather, labdanum and vanilla warm the base, soft and resinous.

name: No 1 Clive Christian for Men
desc: Nutmeg and thyme open aromatic over a bright heart of bergamot, lime, grapefruit and cardamom. Sandalwood, tonka bean, amber and vanilla make a warm, smooth base beneath the citrus.

name: Rock Rose
desc: Bright orange and bergamot with a touch of pepper give way to lavender, violet and clary sage over labdanum, ending in a quiet thread of saffron.

name: X for Women
desc: Bergamot, rhubarb, peach and mandarin open juicy, then rose, jasmine, iris and tuberose bloom into a full bouquet. Vanilla, rum, patchouli and sandalwood leave a sweet, warm finish.

name: Coach Blue
desc: Absinthe and lime open sharply, then sea notes and pepper add a salty, spiced coolness. Amber and cedarwood finish it warm and dry.

name: Coach Dreams
desc: Bitter orange and pear lead to gardenia and a green, cool cactus note. The base is soft woody notes and ambroxan.

name: Coach For Men
desc: Pear, bergamot and kumquat sit over cardamom, coriander and geranium. Vetiver, suede and ambergris give the base a smooth, dry depth.

name: Coach Love
desc: Simple and soft, it moves from strawberry through rose into a quiet base of cedarwood.

name: Absolu Aventus
desc: Crisp ginger, grapefruit and bergamot lead, then cardamom, cinnamon and pineapple add spice and juice. Labdanum, vetiver and patchouli ground it in earthy warmth.

name: Acqua Fiorentina
desc: Plum and apple open juicy and fruity, with rose and carnation blooming at the heart. Bergamot, lemon, cedarwood and sandalwood keep it clear and fresh.

name: Carmina
desc: Cherry, saffron and pink pepper brighten the opening before rose, violet and peony bloom. Frankincense, myrrh, amber and musk give a warm, resinous depth.

name: Centaurus
desc: Cardamom, cinnamon and tobacco open spicy, geranium and heliotrope bring a floral sweetness, and benzoin, tonka bean and vanilla fill the base with warm, balsamic richness.

name: Delphinus
desc: Incense, almond and pink pepper open warm and spicy, with heliotrope and iris giving a powdery heart. Patchouli, tonka bean, leather and vanilla finish deep and sweet.

name: Eladaria
desc: Sparkling mandarin, bergamot and pink pepper lead to rose and peony with a powdery softness. Musk, vanilla and cashmere wood leave it smooth and gentle.

name: Fleurissimo
desc: Clear, green violet leaf and bergamot open the way. Rose, tuberose and ylang-ylang bloom creamily at the heart, with iris and ambergris giving a soft, polished base.

name: Iris Debonair
desc: Absinthe and cardamom give a sharp, herbal opening beside bergamot. Lavender, violet leaf and fig lead to a powdery iris base held by ambrette.

name: Jardin d'Amalfi
desc: Sunlit bergamot and lemon over vetiver and sandalwood, with a dry touch of pepper. Ambergris and musk give the woody citrus a warm, quiet base.

name: Love In Black
desc: Jasmine, violet and cedarwood open soft and powdery, iris and clove add a hint of spice, and blackcurrant, rose and musk leave a dark, smooth finish.

name: Love in White for Summer
desc: Rose, bergamot and magnolia open airy. Iris, basmati rice and cedarwood create a powdery, woody heart, and ambergris with sandalwood end it warm and softly sweet.

name: Neroli Sauvage
desc: A bright citrus burst of bergamot, bitter orange, grapefruit and lemon, with neroli and verbena. Orange blossom and ambergris leave a soft, creamy finish.

name: Original Santal
desc: Coriander, juniper and cinnamon meet creamy sandalwood, with lavender, petitgrain and rosemary adding a herbal freshness. Vanilla and tonka bean warm the base.

name: Oud Zarian
desc: Bergamot, ginger and frankincense open a spiced, resinous scene around rose. Oud, sandalwood and myrrh sit underneath, sweetened by tonka bean and liquorice.

name: Pure White Cologne
desc: Clean citrus from bergamot, lemon and grapefruit meets green galbanum and soft pear. Ambergris, musk and rice powder leave a fresh, airy, slightly powdery trail.

name: Queen of Silk
desc: Osmanthus, magnolia and saffron open golden. Tuberose, passion fruit and a trace of oud add fruit and depth, while vanilla, incense and myrrh give a resinous finish.

name: Royal Princess Oud
desc: Rose and bergamot open bright, jasmine and vanilla fill the heart, and benzoin with sandalwood leave a sweet, resinous warmth.

name: Spring Flower
desc: Bergamot, grapefruit and lemon begin fresh and zesty. Apricot, peach and jasmine add a fruity softness, and ambergris, cedarwood and musk keep it clean.

name: Sublime Vanille
desc: Vanilla opens in a sweet, creamy way, and then tonka bean, lemon and bergamot lift it into sunlight. A gentle musk rounds off the end.

name: Tabarome Millésime
desc: Ginger, pink pepper and grapefruit give a spiced citrus start. Tea, coffee, rum and blackcurrant fill the heart, and sandalwood and tobacco close it warm.

name: Viking Cologne
desc: Lemon, pink pepper, bergamot and mandarin open lively. Lavender, geranium, nutmeg and sage add herbal spice, and sandalwood, patchouli, frankincense, cedarwood and vetiver give a woody base.

name: Wind Flowers
desc: Peach and orange blossom open over a jasmine, tuberose and rose bouquet. Musk, praline, sandalwood and iris leave it creamy and powdery.

name: Cool Water
desc: A cool rush of mint, lavender, rosemary and sea notes opens, with jasmine and geranium softening the heart. Sandalwood, musk and oakmoss give it a clean, mossy base.

name: Addict Eau Fraîche
desc: Bright bergamot opens onto lily of the valley and freesia, then settles on soft musk. A clean, dewy floral that stays light and airy throughout.

name: Dior Homme Parfum
desc: Iris sits at the centre, powdery and cool, wrapped in warm amber and patchouli with a dry vetiver edge. Earthy and softly smooth.

name: Dior Homme Sport
desc: Bergamot brightness gives way to elemi and pink pepper, then settles into a dry, warm frankincense. A crisp, resinous scent with a spicy edge.

name: Fahrenheit Parfum
desc: Mandarin brightens a smoky heart of leather and violet, all of it resting on sweet vanilla. Powdery and dark at the edges, with a quiet warmth underneath.

name: Fahrenheit
desc: Lavender, mandarin and bergamot lift a floral heart of jasmine, honeysuckle and violet leaf, before leather, tonka bean and vetiver take over. Crisp, unusual and gradually warmer.

name: Homme
desc: Earthy and woody from start to finish: cedarwood leads, patchouli adds a damp, dark depth, and vetiver dries everything down to a quiet root.

name: Homme Cologne
desc: A cool splash of bergamot and grapefruit over clean musk. Light, crisp and simple, it reads like freshly laundered linen in morning sun.

name: Hypnotic Poison Eau de Parfum
desc: Jasmine sambac sits in a warm, creamy cloud of tonka bean and vanilla. Sweet, enveloping and slightly narcotic, it unfolds slowly on skin.

name: J'adore Infinissime
desc: A radiant bouquet of rose, jasmine sambac, ylang-ylang and tuberose, brightened by bergamot and blood orange and settling onto creamy sandalwood. Rounded and soft.

name: Miss Dior Absolutely Blooming
desc: Red berries give a juicy first impression before peony and rose open up. A clean musk keeps the whole bouquet light and fresh.

name: Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet
desc: Peony and rose gather in a fresh, airy bouquet, lifted by bergamot and finished with clean, soft musk. Gentle, springlike and uncomplicated.

name: Miss Dior Parfum
desc: Mandarin opens a rounded jasmine heart, then amberwood brings a creamy, glowing warmth. Floral and citrusy at first, softer and deeper as it dries.

name: Miss Dior Rose N'Roses
desc: Rose leads in a sparkling, dewy way, with mandarin adding a citrus lift and soft musk trailing behind. A light, fresh floral.

name: Poison Girl
desc: Bitter orange gives a zesty edge to a bright rose, with tonka bean adding a sweet, soft warmth underneath. Playful and fresh.

name: Pure Poison
desc: Bergamot flickers over orange blossom, resting on soft, creamy musk. A white floral that feels clean, luminous and quietly sweet.

name: Sauvage Eau de Parfum
desc: Spicy and herbal at the heart: Sichuan pepper, anise, nutmeg and lavender, under a bright bergamot lift. Ambroxan and vanilla bring a smooth, warm finish.

name: Sauvage
desc: Sharp, bright bergamot and pepper give way to amberwood with a warm, mineral glow. Crisp, spicy and easy to wear.

name: Sauvage Eau Forte
desc: Cold spices and lavender sit over a smooth musk. Herbal and fresh, with a chilly bite that gradually softens against the skin.

name: Sauvage Extrait
desc: Lavender and bergamot lift the opening before oud, patchouli, vetiver and cedarwood take over. Earthy and resinous underneath, with a fresh, citrus-bright edge that never fully fades.

name: Sauvage Parfum
desc: Mandarin gives a juicy, sunlit opening before sweet tonka bean and creamy sandalwood. Warm and rounded, with citrus keeping it fresh.

name: Do Son
desc: Rose, iris and orange blossom open soft, tuberose and pink pepper fill the heart, and benzoin with musk leave it creamy and warm.

name: Eau de Lierre
desc: Galbanum opens green and sharp, cyclamen adds a cool floral note, and rosewood gives a light, woody finish. Like ivy on a damp wall.

name: Eau de Minthé
desc: Nutmeg and mint start cool and spiced, geranium and rose add a floral heart, and patchouli rounds it with earthy depth.

name: Eau Rose
desc: Lychee and blackcurrant give a juicy lift to a rose and jasmine heart. Honey, musk and cedarwood leave a soft, slightly sweet finish.

name: Ilio
desc: Bergamot, prickly pear and jasmine make a simple, airy line. The fruit stays cool and slightly green, and the jasmine arrives late and soft.

name: L'Eau des Hesperides
desc: Bitter orange and lemon open sharp, mint adds a cooling, herbal lift, and immortelle leaves a dry, golden finish. Fresh and a little bitter.

name: Lunamaris
desc: Pink pepper, incense and labdanum form a slow, resinous line. Spiced at the start, smoky in the middle, warm and balsamic at the close.

name: Philosykos
desc: Fig runs through the whole scent: the leaf, the milky fruit and the woody branch, with coconut and green leaves adding sweetness. Cedarwood grounds it.

name: Vetyverio
desc: A spiced floral heart of geranium, ylang-ylang, rose, nutmeg and clove, brightened by bergamot and mandarin. Vetiver, musk and cedarwood end dry and clean.

name: Devotion Intense, .
desc: Hazelnut, orange blossom and vanilla, soft and sweet. The floral heart turns creamy and warm against a gourmand frame.

name: Intenso
desc: Basil, lavender and sandalwood. Herbal and fresh at first, then a calm woody base that rounds everything out.

name: Light Blue Summer Vibes
desc: Bergamot's bright zest meets juicy peach, held by a dry line of cedarwood. Light, citrusy and fruity, with a clean woody finish.

name: Light Blue
desc: Apple and cedarwood open crisp, with bamboo, jasmine and rose in the heart. Amber and musk soften the finish, giving a breezy, green-floral scent with a lemony brightness.

name: Pour Homme
desc: Neroli, bergamot and mandarin open into lavender, sage and pepper. Sandalwood, tobacco and tonka bean close it. Fresh and herbal, with a warm, spiced base.

name: Q by Dolce&Gabbana
desc: Lemon and blood orange start sharp and juicy, with jasmine adding a floral touch. Cherry and heliotrope bring a powdery sweetness, settling on cedarwood and a clean bed of musk.

name: The One for Men Eau de Parfum
desc: Basil, coriander and grapefruit open aromatic, then cardamom, ginger and orange blossom warm the heart. Cedarwood, tobacco and amber make the base smooth, dry and softly spicy.

name: Green Wood
desc: Lemon, santolina and pepper open sharp and herbal, with cedarwood, vetiver and resins in the heart. Cypriol, ambroxan and musk add a smoky, earthy base with a resinous warmth.

name: Original Wood
desc: Violet leaf, cardamom and an aquatic accord open cool and green, followed by fir balsam, vetiver and cedarwood. Patchouli, amber and musk give the base a soft, earthy depth.

name: Desire Blue
desc: Lychee, mandarin and bergamot lift a watery, citrusy start with lotus. Rosewood and sea notes lead into tonka bean, amber and musk.

name: Icon
desc: Bergamot, neroli and pepper with juniper and sage feel aromatic and sharp, resting on vetiver, leather, oud and a dry touch of iris.

name: London
desc: Bergamot, apple and cardamom brighten geranium, jasmine and rose. Patchouli, sandalwood and vanilla give it a smooth, warm base.

name: White Tea
desc: Rose, maté and tonka bean make a gentle, green-floral blend. Fresh and lightly sweet, it feels airy and softly rounded.

name: Myth
desc: Bergamot, blackcurrant and ambrette lead to orchid, lotus and jasmine. The finish is clean and skin-like, with musk, patchouli and cedarwood.

name: Beautiful
desc: A full bouquet of rose, lily, tuberose and marigold with mandarin, joined by orange blossom and jasmine, then grounded by sandalwood, vetiver and amber.

name: Cinnabar
desc: Mandarin, orange blossom and jasmine open over lily and clove, giving the florals a spicy warmth. Patchouli, sandalwood and frankincense finish the creamy, resinous drydown.

name: White Linen
desc: A powdery floral of rose, jasmine and lily of the valley, softened by iris and grounded in dry vetiver, oakmoss and amber.

name: Youth Dew
desc: Rose, daffodil and lavender open into jasmine and warm spice. Oakmoss, vetiver and patchouli give it an earthy, herbal depth.

name: Musk
desc: Clean, bright and woody: bergamot, grapefruit and verbena over white rose and cedar, with sandalwood, vanilla and a musk finish.

name: Udaipur
desc: Floral and creamy: bergamot, pink pepper and magnolia over jasmine sambac, gardenia and lotus, ending on patchouli, cashmere wood and musk.

name: Via Verri
desc: Peppery citrus meets flowers: bergamot, pepper and jasmine, then iris, rose and cardamom, resting on cypress, amber and musk.

name: Blue Talisman Extrait
desc: Pear and bergamot brighten orange blossom and jasmine. Vanilla, sandalwood and musk with amberwood make a creamy, glowing base. Floral, warm and smooth.

name: Demon Dancer
desc: Rhubarb, mint and blood orange give a tart, sparkling start. Orange blossom and blackcurrant follow, with Georgywood, musk and tonka bean for a woody, clean base.

name: Fleur Narcotique Extrait
desc: Bergamot, lychee and osmanthus open juicy and bright, then peony, orange blossom, jasmine and freesia fill the heart. Sandalwood, oakmoss and musk give it a smooth, creamy finish.

name: Speed Legends
desc: Bergamot, mandarin and pink pepper open sharp and sunny, with clary sage and blackcurrant in the heart. Tonka bean, vetiver and amberwood add a warm, dry base.

name: London Spice
desc: Lemon, bergamot and mint open crisp, then lavender, jasmine and sea notes make a breezy heart. Patchouli, cedarwood, nutmeg and cardamom warm the base with a gentle spice.

name: Lucius
desc: Pink pepper, mandarin and bergamot sparkle first, then cedarwood and orange blossom, drying into tonka bean, vetiver and amber.

name: Oud Noir Intense Parfum
desc: Bergamot and cardamom open bright and spiced, with rose and jasmine in the heart. Sandalwood, saffron, patchouli, vanilla and amber make a rich, warm and slightly sweet base.

name: Oud Orange Intense
desc: Coconut and sweet fruit open soft and creamy, then vanilla takes over the heart. Musk and oud close it, a warm, resinous scent with a smooth, sugary glow.

name: Eau de Magnolia
desc: Bergamot lifts an earthy magnolia heart threaded with vetiver and patchouli. Cedarwood, oakmoss and amber give it a mossy, woody base.

name: Music for a While
desc: A fruity, comforting blend: lemon, mandarin and bergamot with lavender, falling to patchouli and labdanum.

name: Northern Love
desc: Speculoos, saffron, nutmeg and cinnamon open like warm baking spice. Vanilla and jasmine soften the heart, and sandalwood, balsam of Peru, patchouli, leather and styrax leave a smoky, sweet base.

name: Promise
desc: Pink pepper, rosemary and apple open crisp. Rose and Turkish rose are spiced with clove, then patchouli, ambroxan, labdanum and cypriol add an earthy, resinous depth.

name: Sale Gosse
desc: A radiant, citrus-led blend: neroli, bergamot and petitgrain over a floral heart of daffodil, rose and violet, resting on musk.

name: The Moon
desc: Raspberry, lychee and saffron open fruity and golden. Frankincense and Turkish rose form the heart, and oud and leather give a dark, smooth base.

name: Liquid Brun
desc: Cinnamon, cardamom and bergamot meet orange blossom, then deepen into vanilla and elemi. Praline, musk and guaiac wood leave a sweet, resinous warmth.

name: Angel Dust
desc: Amber opens warm and glowing, pink pepper adds a bright spice, and wood fills the heart. Cashmere wood gives the base a soft, smooth, dry finish.

name: Orange Crush
desc: Orange is juicy and bright, sitting over a clear heart of musk. Pepperwood and akigalawood add a dry, peppery warmth underneath, so the citrus fades into something clean and woody.

name: Parfum 1
desc: Citrus, blackcurrant, mint and mandarin open fresh and green, followed by davana, frankincense, orange blossom and pink pepper. Patchouli, musk, sandalwood and cedarwood make a soft, woody base.

name: Passionfroudh
desc: Ginger, marigold, tea and passion fruit open tangy and bright, with mango, pepper, rose and frankincense in the heart. Gurjum balsam, cypriol and oud give a deep, resinous base.

name: Sugardaddy
desc: Mandarin, bergamot and blackcurrant open juicy, then nutmeg, clove, jasmine and ambergris add warm spice. Oakmoss, cashmere wood and patchouli make a dark, earthy finish.

desc: Mandarin, coconut, almond and hazelnut open sweet and nutty, then vanilla, tonka bean and jasmine make a creamy heart. Crème brûlée, amber and musk end it soft and sugared.

desc: Caramel and honey give a milky sweetness, with coumarin adding a warm hay-like softness. Vanilla and musk close it clean and gentle, like warm milk with a spoonful of sugar.

name: Ange ou Démon
desc: Mandarin, thyme and saffron open bright and herbal, lily forms a fresh floral heart, and oakwood leaves a dry, woody close.

name: Gentleman Eau de Toilette
desc: Pear and violet leaf open green and fruity, iris and lavender form a powdery, herbal heart, and leather and patchouli close dry and earthy.

name: Gentleman Society
desc: Sage and cardamom open herbal and spiced, daffodil and vetiver form a floral, earthy heart, and cedarwood, sandalwood and vanilla close warm and woody.

name: Irresistible Givenchy
desc: A soft pear and ambrette start moves into rose and iris, powdery and fruity, set on clean cedarwood and white woods.

name: Irresistible
desc: Pear and ambrette brighten the start, rose and iris form a powdery floral centre, and cedarwood with white woods holds it all together.

name: You Doux
desc: Violet and a hush of powder sit above palo santo, frankincense and myrrh, resting on soft ambrette and ambroxan.

name: Bloom Intense
desc: Pear and ginger lead into a creamy bouquet of jasmine and orange blossom, then drift down to earthy patchouli and a soft coconut warmth.

name: Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense
desc: Mandarin opens bright, gardenia forms a creamy floral heart, and sandalwood leaves a smooth, woody finish.

name: Flora Gorgeous Jasmine
desc: Mandarin, bergamot and pepper open bright, jasmine, magnolia, jasmine sambac and rose make a creamy floral heart, and sandalwood, benzoin and patchouli close warm.

name: Gucci Bloom Acqua di Fiori
desc: Galbanum and blackcurrant add a green, fruity sparkle to creamy tuberose, jasmine and honeysuckle. Musk and sandalwood keep it soft.

name: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia
desc: Magnolia, jasmine sambac and lily of the valley bloom over blackberry and coconut. Musk and white woods keep the creamy floral clean and smooth.

name: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid
desc: Vanilla runs from start to finish, softened by a salty hint of sea notes. Sweet and warm, with a fresh, airy edge.

name: Gucci Guilty Absolute
desc: Leather, cypress and patchouli sit over vetiver and dry woods. Earthy and green, with a smoky depth that feels dark and textured.

name: Gucci Intense Oud
desc: Pepper and frankincense open onto amberwood, sandalwood and cedarwood. Leather, patchouli and oud sit at the base, giving a resinous, warm and woody depth.

name: Gucci Oud
desc: Pear, raspberry and saffron brighten a heart of rose and orange blossom. Oud and patchouli ground it, making a fruity floral with an earthy, spiced core.

name: Gucci Pour Homme
desc: Bergamot, cypress and violet open green and bright, jasmine and tobacco form a smoky heart, and frankincense, amber, patchouli, leather and elemi close resinous and warm.

name: Guilty Elixir de Parfum Pour Femme
desc: Bergamot and violet brighten the start before wisteria, rose and osmanthus open into a petal heart, settling onto vanilla, tonka bean and patchouli.

name: Guilty Intense pour Homme
desc: Salt opens with a mineral edge, lavender forms an herbal heart, and palo santo leaves a soft, woody close.

name: Angélique Noire
desc: Angelica carries a green, peppery bite through jasmine sambac and caraway, then returns in the base alongside vanilla and cedarwood. Spicy, earthy and softly floral.

name: Aqua Allegoria Bergamote Calabria
desc: Crisp and bright with bergamot, pink pepper and green leaves. Cardamom and ginger warm the heart, and musk with vanilla gently round off the end.

name: Aqua Allegoria Florabloom
desc: Bergamot, lime and mango sparkle over tuberose, rose, iris and violet. Musk, sandalwood and coconut leave a soft, powdery, slightly tropical trail.

name: Aqua Allegoria Forte Mandarine Basilic
desc: Mandarin and basil open crisp and herbal, with a touch of blackcurrant. Rose, vanilla and orange blossom fill the heart before cedarwood, sandalwood and musk finish it.

name: Aqua Allegoria Forte Nerolia Vetiver
desc: Green and juicy at first: bergamot, petitgrain and fig. Neroli and rose flower in the heart, and vetiver, cedarwood and tonka bean ground the dry-down.

name: Aqua Allegoria Nerolia Vetiver
desc: Basil, bergamot and lemon open sharp and green. Fig, orange blossom and rose soften the heart, and neroli, vetiver and musk leave a clean, airy trail.

name: Aqua Allegoria Pera Granita
desc: Grapefruit, lemon and bergamot start icy and bright. Pear, osmanthus and orange blossom follow, with oakmoss, musk and cedarwood adding a soft, mossy depth.

name: Cruel Gardénia
desc: Rose, peach and neroli give a soft, fruity start before gardenia and ylang-ylang bloom. Musk, tonka bean, vanilla and sandalwood finish creamy and sweet.

name: Cuir Béluga
desc: Aldehydes and mandarin open airy and powdery. Patchouli and immortelle give an earthy heart, and vanilla, amber, heliotrope and suede end soft and velvety.

name: Mon Guerlain Intense
desc: Sunny bergamot, mandarin and lavender open fresh. Jasmine sambac and vanilla build a sweet heart, over musk, patchouli and sandalwood.

name: Néroli Outrenoir
desc: Crisp petitgrain and bergamot lead into orange blossom and neroli, with a thread of smoked tea. Amber, oakmoss and myrrh darken the end.

name: Samsara
desc: Honeysuckle opens softly into jasmine and ylang-ylang, before sandalwood, iris, tonka bean and vanilla settle in. Creamy, warm and floral.

name: Santal Royal
desc: Neroli and jasmine open over peach, rose and a thread of cinnamon. Sandalwood, leather, amber, oud and musk close it out, floral first and then slowly warm.

name: Spiritueuse Double Vanille
desc: Pink pepper, bergamot and frankincense open lightly spiced. Rose, jasmine and ylang-ylang bloom in the heart, then vanilla, benzoin, rum and cedarwood warm the base.

name: Bella Vita
desc: Blackcurrant, cherry and lemon give a juicy lift to jasmine, tuberose and vanilla. Musk, praline, tonka bean and amberwood close the scent.

name: Seductive
desc: Bergamot, blackcurrant and pear open fruity, followed by jasmine, orange blossom and a powdery iris. Frankincense and vanilla warm the base.

name: Seductive Homme,
desc: Mandarin, cardamom and pink pepper lead into violet and vetiver, with a powdery, earthy softness. Amber, sandalwood and patchouli give it a warm, woody base.

name: 24, Faubourg
desc: Orange, peach and hyacinth glow over iris, gardenia and orange blossom. Vanilla, amber and sandalwood make the dry-down creamy, powdery and gently warm.

name: Calèche
desc: Aldehydes, bergamot and neroli open sparkling, iris, rose and jasmine form a powdery, classic floral heart, and sandalwood, amber and oakmoss end soft and mossy.

name: Jour d'Hermès
desc: Grapefruit, lemon and sea notes open crisp, with gardenia and green leaves in the heart. Musk and woody notes leave it airy and light.

name: Terre d'Hermès Eau Intense Vétiver
desc: Grapefruit, bergamot and orange open zesty. Pepper, geranium and patchouli add a peppery heart, and vetiver, cedarwood and benzoin leave an earthy, dry base.

name: Festival Nite
desc: Coconut, freesia and mandarin start light and creamy. Apple blossom and orchid lead to a soft, sweet base of vanilla, marshmallow and amber.

name: BOSS Bottled Beyond
desc: Ginger opens with a hot, zesty bite, followed by a smoky leather heart. Woody notes in the base keep it dry and dark, giving the spice a rugged, smoulderingly warm edge.

name: Boss Bottled Parfum
desc: Mandarin and incense open into iris and fig. Cedarwood and leather support them. A fruity, powdery scent with a dry, woody and smoky backdrop.

name: Boss Bottled Triumph Elixir
desc: Violet leaf brings a green, slightly watery start, and vetiver gives the heart a dry, earthy backbone. Patchouli deepens the base, so the scent feels cool and grounded.

name: BOSS In Motion
desc: Basil, bergamot and violet leaf start fresh, while cardamom, nutmeg, cinnamon and pink pepper make the middle spicy. Musk, sandalwood and vetiver close it woody.

name: The Scent for Her

desc: Strawberry, blueberry, peach and saffron open sweet and fruity, then rose, jasmine and heliotrope soften the heart. Patchouli, oud, musk and vanilla give it a dark, warm base.

name: Annone
desc: Bergamot, saffron and mango open bright and golden, followed by rose and iris in a powdery floral heart. Musk, amber, cypriol and oud give the base a resinous, smoky warmth.

name: Auris
desc: Grapefruit, lime, yuzu and lychee open zesty and juicy, with ginger, mint, myrtle and juniper making a cool, herbal heart. Ambergris, tonka bean and cedarwood leave a smooth, woody base.

name: Così Blu
desc: Cardamom, nutmeg and strawberry open spiced and fruity, then magnolia, rose and jasmine bloom softly. Incense, sandalwood, ambergris and musk leave a creamy, smoky finish.

name: Dolce Passione
desc: Honey and chocolate open rich and dark, with plum, strawberry and vanilla in a sweet, fruity heart. Mushroom and tonka bean add an earthy, smooth base, giving the sweetness real depth.

name: Donna Margherita
desc: Jasmine and tuberose open lush, with daffodil, frangipani and lily of the valley adding a creamy, green floral heart. Amber and musk soften the base into a warm, glowing finish.

name: Il Giardino
desc: Ivy opens green and cool, with apple, pear and vetiver in a fresh, earthy heart. Leather, cedarwood, benzoin and musk give the base a dry, smooth, slightly resinous warmth.

name: M
desc: Blackcurrant, plum, raspberry and strawberry open sweet and jammy, then lily of the valley, iris, rose and Turkish rose make a powdery floral heart. Labdanum, patchouli and ambergris finish it warm.

name: Pantheon R
desc: Cinnamon, thyme, strawberry and rhubarb open tart and spiced, then iris, jasmine and saffron fill the heart. Balsam of Peru, incense, labdanum, oud and leather make a deep, resinous base.

name: Raffaello
desc: Absinthe opens green and herbal, then tonka bean, pepper and pink pepper make the heart sweet and spiced. Leather, teak wood and patchouli close it dry and woody.

name: Althaïr Exclusif
desc: Bergamot, amaretto and saffron open sweet and spiced. Cinnamon, orange blossom and cardamom bloom, then praline, vanilla and guaiac wood leave a rich, warm base.

name: Athalia
desc: Bitter orange and incense lead into a powdery heart of iris and orange blossom, ending in warm amber, suede and vanilla.

name: Athénaïs
desc: Neroli, bergamot and yuzu lift an airy opening. Orange blossom and jasmine bloom softly, with tonka bean, vanilla and ambroxan leaving a creamy, sweet trail.

name: Carios
desc: Saffron and pink pepper add spark to bergamot and mandarin. Geranium, thyme and pepper follow, while cedarwood, ambroxan, vetiver and tonka bean warm the base.

name: Cassili
desc: Red currant and rose open with a juicy sweetness. Plum, mimosa and frangipani give a powdery floral heart, ending on sandalwood, tonka bean and vanilla.

name: Castley
desc: A peppery, bright start of bergamot and ginger. Petitgrain, Sichuan pepper and neroli add a green, floral note, resting on akigalawood, labdanum and benzoin.

name: Delina Exclusif
desc: Turkish rose and incense carry a resinous heart, brightened by bergamot, pear and lychee. Oud, amber and vanilla sweeten and deepen the base.

name: Delina La Rosée
desc: Lychee and pear sweeten a rose and peony heart, with bergamot at the start and a soft, warm base of musk and vanilla.

name: Eragon
desc: Bergamot, pink pepper, cardamom and mandarin open bright and spiced. Cinnamon, davana and cypriol give an earthy heart, and leather, tonka bean, vanilla and patchouli end warm.

name: Greenley
desc: Bergamot, mandarin and crisp apple stay bright over a smooth, ambery base of cedarwood. Fresh and sunlit, with a gentle warmth underneath.

name: Meliora
desc: Blackcurrant, raspberry and lemon spark over rose and ylang-ylang, then melt into a sweet base of vanilla, musk and praline.

name: Oriana
desc: Mandarin, lemon and grapefruit open sparkling. Orange blossom, jasmine and chantilly cream turn sweet, and marshmallow, praline, ambroxan and musk give a soft, sugary end.

name: Palatine
desc: Mandarin and pear start crisp and clean, moving through violet and jasmine toward a dry base of sandalwood and musk.

name: Safanad
desc: Creamy ylang-ylang, orange blossom and jasmine glow beneath bright orange and pear, softened by vanilla and sandalwood at the close.

name: Valero
desc: Bergamot, cedrat and juniper open sharp and green. Geranium, lavender, cypress and nutmeg follow, and patchouli, sandalwood and ambroxan finish dry and clean.

name: Changing Constance
desc: Spicy-sweet and smoky: cardamom, salted caramel and tobacco.

name: Changing Constance Intense
desc: A stronger, spicier take: saffron, pimento and salted caramel.

name: Empressa
desc: Soft peach with bergamot, deepened by patchouli.

name: Fortuitous Finley
desc: Green and leathery with a creamy twist: pistachio, violet leaf and leather.

name: Halfeti
desc: A rich oriental built on saffron, cardamom, cinnamon and rose, opening with grapefruit and bergamot. Leather, oud, amber and vanilla give a deep, resinous, smoky base.

name: The Blazing Mr Sam
desc: Cardamom opens bright, and cinnamon and pepper turn up the heat in the heart. Cedarwood, patchouli and tobacco form a dry, earthy, warm base.

name: The Coveted Duchess Rose Intense
desc: A deeper, sweeter rose: vanilla, rose and amber.

name: The Favourite
desc: Green, soft and powdery: violet leaf, mimosa and musk.

name: The Manoeuvres of the Baroness
desc: Creamy and floral: orange blossom, chantilly and sandalwood.

name: The Tragedy of Lord George
desc: Lavender and rum open aromatic and boozy, with tonka bean making the heart sweet and smooth. Ambroxan, vetiver and cedarwood dry the finish into something warm and woody.

name: Missing Person
desc: Musk, bergamot and jasmine lead to cyclamen, neroli and orange blossom. Sandalwood and pale woods leave a clean, skin-close warmth.

name: Vanilla Skin
desc: Pink pepper, apple and sugar brighten a heart of lily, jasmine and cashmere wood. Benzoin, vanilla, sandalwood and a little oud finish it.

name: Amber
desc: Mimosa, bitter orange, mandarin and bergamot open sunny. Rose and patchouli bring an earthy floral heart, and tonka bean, vanilla, sandalwood and benzoin leave a sweet, soft base.

name: Candy
desc: Musk, benzoin and caramel: sweet, resinous and snug. A warm gourmand that stays soft and close.

name: Candy Gloss
desc: Blackcurrant and cherry open juicy, orange blossom and peach add a fruity floral heart, and heliotrope, musk and benzoin leave a powdery, resinous finish.

name: La Femme Intense
desc: Tuberose and ylang-ylang make a lush, creamy floral, deepened by earthy patchouli. Dense, flowery and dark at the edges.

name: Les Infusions Iris
desc: Iris, mandarin and neroli open fresh and clean. Cedarwood, vetiver and galbanum add a green, woody structure, while incense and benzoin soften the base.

name: Les Infusions Mandarine
desc: Bitter orange and a touch of mandarin start bright, orange blossom and neroli bring a floral heart, and opoponax adds a creamy, resinous finish.

name: Luna Rossa
desc: Bitter orange and lavender open fresh and herbal. Clary sage and mint cool the heart, and ambrette and ambroxan leave a clean, amber-tinged base.

name: Luna Rossa Sport
desc: Ginger and juniper open sharp and fresh. Tonka bean and vanilla add a sweet warmth, with lavender running through for an aromatic edge.

name: Olfactories Cargo de Nuit
desc: Musk and aldehydes begin airy, woody notes and a mineral accord add a salty dryness, and coumarin with ambroxan leaves a powdery, warm trail.

name: Olfactories Nue Au Soleil
desc: Orange blossom and neroli give a creamy, sunlit floral, resting on patchouli and musk. Soft, skin-warm and slightly earthy.

name: Olfactories Purple Rain
desc: Iris, orange blossom and vetiver make a powdery, creamy floral with an earthy backbone. Quiet and soft, with a cool, dry edge.

name: Paradoxe Intense
desc: Bergamot, neroli and pear open bright, jasmine and oakmoss add a green floral depth, and amber, vanilla and musk make the base creamy and warm.

name: Paradoxe Sweet Chemistry
desc: Blackcurrant opens fruity and tart, orange blossom brings a creamy floral sweetness, and neroli keeps it light.

name: Paradoxe Virtual Flower
desc: Bergamot lights the way to a clean jasmine heart, resting on a bed of musk. Creamy, airy and floral, with very little clutter.

name: 1 Million Lucky
desc: Grapefruit, sea notes and plum open fresh and juicy. Jasmine, cashmere wood, hazelnut and honey add sweet warmth, and patchouli, vetiver and oakmoss ground the end.

name: 1 Million Privé
desc: Mandarin, cinnamon and apple open warm and bright. Tobacco and myrrh make a smoky, resinous heart, and patchouli with tonka bean leaves a sweet, earthy base.

name: 1 Million
desc: Mint and mandarin start cool, then cinnamon and rose bring heat and sweetness. A base of leather and Amberketal makes it warm and spicy.

name: Fame in Love
desc: Mandarin, strawberry and basil open fruity and fresh. Incense, iris and jasmine create a powdery heart, and a mineral accord, vanilla and patchouli complete the base.

name: Fame Parfum
desc: Incense opens with a faint smoke, musk brings a clean softness, and jasmine adds a gentle floral glow. Resinous, smooth and quiet.

name: Invictus Legend
desc: Grapefruit and sea notes open salty and crisp, laurel leaf and geranium add an herbal heart, and guaiac wood with amber leaves a warm, smoky base.

name: Invictus Platinum
desc: Grapefruit opens sharp, lavender and oakmoss create an herbal, mossy heart, and mint and patchouli add a cool, earthy finish.

name: Invictus
desc: Grapefruit, sea notes and mandarin start bright and salty. Bay and jasmine form the heart, and guaiac wood, oakmoss, patchouli and ambergris leave a mossy, earthy base.

name: Invictus Victory Elixir
desc: Lavandin, cardamom and pepper open aromatic and spiced. Incense and patchouli bring an earthy, smoky heart, and vanilla and tonka bean end sweet and warm.

name: Lady Million Empire
desc: Orange, neroli and red currant open juicy. Magnolia, orange blossom, osmanthus and plum create a lush floral heart, and cognac, patchouli and musk add a warm, boozy depth.

name: Lady Million Fabulous
desc: Mandarin, pink pepper and sea notes open bright. Jasmine, tuberose and ylang-ylang bloom creamily, and vanilla, oakmoss and tonka bean leave a sweet, mossy finish.

name: Lady Million Privé
desc: Orange blossom opens soft over woody notes, heliotrope and raspberry sweeten the heart, and chocolate, honey and patchouli leave a rich, powdery base.

name: Million Gold For Her Le Parfum
desc: Ylang-ylang, jasmine and sandalwood in a simple, creamy line. The flowers are rich but soft, and the wood keeps things smooth.

name: Phantom in Red
desc: Plum, saffron and bergamot open fruity and spiced. Lavender, sage and orange blossom shape the heart, and amberwood, benzoin, tobacco and oud give a resinous, warm base.

name: Phantom Parfum
desc: Vetiver and lavender run side by side, one earthy and one aromatic, with vanilla adding a sweet softness. Herbal, fresh and smooth.

name: Pure Xs for Her
desc: Ylang-ylang and vanilla open sweet and floral, popcorn and ambrette add a toasty, musky heart, and vanilla returns with sandalwood for a warm, soft base.

name: Beyond Romance
desc: Raspberry, mandarin and bergamot open sparkling, followed by rose, jasmine and lily of the valley. Vanilla, cashmeran and musk soften the base into something fresh and floral.

name: Romance
desc: Mandarin, pink pepper and violet leaf open bright and slightly peppery, then rose, jasmine and marigold bloom in the heart. Patchouli, oakmoss and musk lend an earthy, powdery finish.

name: Elixir
desc: Bergamot and artemisia give a green, aromatic start. Lavender and benzoin follow, drying into a smooth base of vanilla and tonka bean.

name: Pacific Aura
desc: Blackcurrant, lemon and mint sparkle over apricot, basil and rose, before dates, fig and ambrette add a mellow, sunny sweetness.

name: Nude
desc: Guava, mandarin and pear brighten a creamy bouquet of orange blossom, jasmine sambac and gardenia, which settles into sandalwood, orchid and musk.

name: Fiamma
desc: Pear opens soft and juicy, and gardenia glows at the heart, touched with spice. Amber closes it warm, a floral that turns slowly from fruit to a golden, spiced base.

name: Feminite Du Bois
desc: Cedarwood wrapped in spice and sweetness: honey, cinnamon, clove and cardamom, with plum, peach and violet in the heart. Sandalwood, benzoin, vanilla and musk keep it warm, dense and lingering.

name: La Fille de Berlin
desc: Rose and geranium open bold and floral, with palmarosa giving a green, bright edge. Patchouli, honey and oakmoss darken the base, sweet and earthy in equal measure.

name: Il Padrino
desc: Amaretto, blackcurrant, rum and bergamot open sweet and boozy, with amber, patchouli and sandalwood in the heart. Labdanum, vanilla and benzoin leave a rich, resinous glow.

name: Crying of Evil
desc: Pink pepper, tuberose, violet and spice open rich and floral, with sandalwood, leather and rose in the heart. Patchouli, amber, frankincense and musk make a dark, resinous base.

name: God of Fire
desc: Mango, lemon, pink pepper and ginger open bright and fruity, then coumarin, jasmine and dry wood warm the heart. Oud, cypriol, musk and amber give it a smoky, spiced base.

name: Lady White Snake
desc: Mandarin, orange blossom and honeysuckle open sweet and bright, with magnolia, tuberose and jasmine in a creamy heart. Amber, leather and musk give the base a smoky, soft warmth.

name: Wonderstruck
desc: Freesia, blackberry, raspberry and apple blossom make a bright berry-floral start. Vanilla and honeysuckle follow, softening into musk, sandalwood and peach.

name: Halley
desc: Passion fruit, blackcurrant and rose open juicy and bright, with a long floral heart of iris, tuberose and peach. Vanilla, oud and cedarwood end warm.

name: Orza
desc: Apple, plum and coconut lead into jasmine, rose and lily of the valley. Sandalwood, vanilla and caramel make the finish creamy, sweet and softly floral.

name: Porpora
desc: Rose and raspberry begin with a hint of cinnamon, and incense gives the heart a smoky edge. Benzoin, myrrh and amber leave a resinous, warm base.

name: Black Lacquer
desc: A glossy ink-dark opening leads to ebony wood and a smoky, resinous frankincense base. Quiet, dense and woody, with a warm finish.

name: Black Orchid Reserve
desc: Bergamot and an earthy touch of mushroom introduce orchid and ylang-ylang. Chocolate, patchouli, tonka bean and vanilla make the base sweet, dark and rounded.

name: Bois Pacifique
desc: Turmeric adds a dry, golden spice at the top, leaving sandalwood and oakwood to take over. Woody, warm and quiet.

name: Eau de Soleil Blanc
desc: Sun-warmed bergamot over creamy ylang-ylang, finishing on coco de mer. Soft, floral and lightly sweet, like skin after a day outdoors.

name: Fougère D'Argent
desc: Mandarin, lavender and ginger lead into labdanum and akigalawood. Coumarin rounds it off with a warm, sweet, woody softness.

name: Grey Vetiver
desc: Grapefruit, orange blossom and sage open sharp, then nutmeg, iris and pimento add a powdery spice. Vetiver, amber and oakmoss ground it in earthy warmth.

name: Jasmin Rouge
desc: Bergamot, mandarin and a quartet of spices open warm. Jasmine sambac and ylang-ylang bloom in the heart, then vanilla, labdanum, leather and amber give a creamy, resinous finish.

name: Mandarino di Amalfi
desc: A garden of citrus and herbs: tarragon, mint, basil, grapefruit and lemon over orange blossom and jasmine. Vetiver, amber and musk quietly hold the base.

name: Myrrhe Mystère
desc: Sandalwood and myrrh trade places from opening to heart, then rest on Ultravanil, amber, vetiver and cedarwood. A warm, resinous, quietly sweet scent.

name: Neroli Portofino Parfum
desc: Neroli threads through every stage, from blood orange and lemon to clary sage and jasmine sambac. Musk and amber give it a creamy, clean landing.

name: Noir Extreme
desc: Mandarin, saffron and cardamom open spiced and glowing. Orange blossom and jasmine soften the heart, while vanilla, sandalwood and amber give a rich, creamy base.

name: Oud Minérale
desc: Sea notes meet oud in a salty, resinous blend, finished with ambergris. Mineral and rich, it smells like warm rock beside cool water.

name: Oud Voyager
desc: Geranium and peony soften the start, then osmanthus meets oud, which carries through to a base of cypriol. Floral, earthy and richly resinous.

name: Santal Blush
desc: Sandalwood sits creamy and smooth, with cinnamon adding a gentle spice and ylang-ylang a soft floral lift. Warm, rounded and subtle.

name: Soleil de Feu
desc: Tuberose, sandalwood and benzoin, just three notes. Creamy white flower meets a smooth woody resin that feels sunlit and rich.

name: Taormina Orange
desc: Blood orange and bitter orange stay juicy and sharp, while oakmoss adds an earthy, shaded finish. Clean citrus with a bit of grit.

name: Vanilla Sex
desc: Almond opens into layers of vanilla, tonka bean and Ultravanil, with floral notes and sandalwood behind them. Sweet, warm and smooth.

name: Velvet Orchid
desc: Bergamot, mandarin and honey open the door to a thick floral heart of jasmine, rose, orchid and magnolia. Suede, myrrh and sandalwood finish plush and resinous.

name: White Suede
desc: Tea and thyme open crisply, then rose, lily of the valley and saffron lead into suede, musk, amber and sandalwood. Soft, floral and faintly spiced.

name: Behind the Curtain Piazza alla Scala
desc: Warm, spiced woods: bergamot, saffron and clove over jasmine, labdanum and juniper, ending on cedar, sandalwood and patchouli.

name: District of Nolo
desc: Fresh and fruity-floral: lemon, pear and violet leaf, iris and rose at the heart, and a base of musk and vanilla.

name: I Vicoli Via Fiori Chiari
desc: Warm and spicy with sweetness: anise, cardamom and lemon over pepper and patchouli, ending on vanilla and a liqueur accord.

name: Limitless Shopping Via della Spiga
desc: A sweet floral with honey: bergamot, apple and honey over rose and jasmine, resting on heliotrope, tonka bean and musk.

name: Musc Noir Perfume Enhancer
desc: A musky-floral blend: iris and lime open to jasmine, resting on cedarwood and musk.

name: My Name
desc: Violet and heliotrope open powdery and sweet, with lilac, musk and lily in the heart. Amber and vanilla give the base a warm, enveloping softness.

name: Primo
desc: Grapefruit and maple make a bright, slightly sweet opening, with geranium and pimento adding floral spice. Patchouli and wood ground the base, warm and earthy.

name: Ruby Red
desc: Bergamot, red fruits and ginger open juicy and bright, then cinnamon, ylang-ylang and vanilla make the heart warm and sweet. Sandalwood and patchouli ground it, smooth and spiced.

name: The Italian Artists of Via Solferino
desc: Mineral and tea-like at the start, with magnolia, ginger and peony in the centre, resting on heliotrope, patchouli and suede.

name: The Street Artists of Isola
desc: Airy and musky: ambrette, water lily and cyclamen over fennel and iris, closing on musk and white woods.

name: Trussardi Black Extreme
desc: Green and powdery with a dark base: lemon, galbanum and cypress over iris, plum and violet, then patchouli, vetiver and leather.

name: Trussardi Elegantly Cool
desc: Soft and creamy: sesame, neroli and grapefruit lead to mimosa, ylang-ylang and jasmine, finishing on musk, tonka bean and sandalwood.

name: Trussardi Pure Jasmine
desc: A creamy jasmine: bergamot, pistachio and neroli open to champaca and jasmine, resting on patchouli, sandalwood and vanilla.

name: Trussardi Uomo
desc: A classic fresh masculine: lemon, bergamot and nutmeg, clary sage, geranium and violet over patchouli, musk and leather.

name: Walking in Porta Venezia
desc: Aromatic and warm: anise, lemon and pepper over violet, absinthe and geranium, ending on patchouli, vanilla and cedar.

name: Walking on Via Fiori Oscuri
desc: A powdery, sweet floral: mandarin and bergamot, mimosa, magnolia and rose, resting on rice powder, tonka bean and vanilla.

name: Born in Roma Purple Melancholia
desc: Plum, osmanthus and vanilla are the whole story here. The fruit is dark and sweet, the flower soft, and the vanilla lingers warm.

name: Born In Roma Uomo
desc: Violet leaf and vetiver open green, salt and sage add a mineral, herbal note, and wood and ginger leave a dry, spiced finish.

name: Donna
desc: Rose and iris form the heart, lit by bergamot and saffron. Leather, patchouli and vanilla give a powdery, warm base.

name: Donna Born in Roma Coral Fantasy
desc: Orange opens sunny, jasmine and rose bloom softly, and ambrette with musk leaves a clean, skin-close finish.

name: Donna Born in Roma Green Stravaganza
desc: Smoked tea hangs over jasmine and vanilla, giving a creamy floral a faint trail of smoke. Sweet, soft and slightly unexpected.

name: Donna Born in Roma Intense
desc: Jasmine in a sweet cloud of vanilla, held warm by resinous benzoin. A soft floral with a creamy, amber-like finish.

name: Donna Born in Roma Yellow Dream
desc: Juicy lychee, bergamot and lemon open bright. Peony and Turkish rose follow, and musk, vanilla and cedarwood keep it soft and clean.

name: Uomo Born in Roma Coral Fantasy
desc: Apple and bergamot open juicy, sage and geranium add an herbal heart, and vanilla, tobacco and patchouli make a sweet, earthy base.

name: Uomo Born in Roma Green Stravaganza
desc: Bergamot gives a bright lift before a sweet, roasted coffee heart. Vetiver adds an earthy, green warmth underneath.

name: Uomo Born in Roma Yellow Dream
desc: Pineapple, lime and mandarin open bright and sweet. Lavender, geranium and gingerbread add warm spice, and vanilla, amber and cedarwood end smooth.

name: Uomo
desc: Bergamot opens clean, then coffee, hazelnut and chocolate create a sweet, roasted heart. Leather and cedarwood add a dry, woody base.

name: Valentina
desc: Strawberry and bergamot open fruity. Jasmine and patchouli add a floral, earthy heart, and cedarwood with vanilla leaves a sweet, woody finish.

name: Valentino Voce Viva Intensa
desc: Bergamot and orange blossom open a heart of jasmine sambac and more orange blossom. Vanilla and oakmoss round it into a creamy, sweet floral.

name: Vendetta Uomo
desc: Ginger, cinnamon and patchouli form a simple, spiced line. Warm and earthy, it moves from a bright bite to a deep, dark finish.

name: Bright Crystal Absolu
desc: Yuzu and pomegranate sparkle first. Raspberry, lotus, peony and magnolia form a juicy floral heart that dries down to mahogany, musk and amber.

name: Dylan Blue Pour Homme
desc: Aquatic accord, fig, bergamot and grapefruit open fresh. Violet leaf, patchouli, papyrus and pepper follow, and musk, tonka bean, saffron and frankincense add warm depth.

name: Eros Eau de Parfum
desc: Lemon, mandarin, mint and apple open cool and green. Geranium and clary sage add a herbal heart, and cedarwood, vetiver, patchouli, sandalwood and vanilla make a woody, sweet base.

name: Eros Eau de Toilette
desc: Mint, lemon and apple open crisp. Tonka bean and geranium add sweetness, and vanilla, vetiver, cedarwood and oakmoss leave a warm, mossy finish.

name: Eros Najim
desc: Mandarin, clary sage, saffron and cardamom open golden. Oud, cedarwood and caramel create a sweet, resinous heart, and patchouli, vetiver, incense and tonka bean end deep and warm.

name: Eros Parfum
desc: Lemon, mandarin and pepper open fresh and bright. Geranium, clary sage and lavender shape the heart, and cashmeran, benzoin, vetiver, patchouli and vanilla add a sweet, woody base.

name: Man Eau Fraiche
desc: Lemon, rose and carambola open bright and juicy. Tarragon, clary sage and cedarwood create an herbal, woody heart, and sycamore wood, amber and musk end clean.

name: Red Jeans
desc: Freesia, red currant and water lily open light and watery. Peony, gardenia and violet follow, drying into a creamy base of musk, sandalwood and vanilla.

name: Dreamer

name: Mango Skin
desc: Blackberry, mango and pepper open juicy with a hint of spice, then iris, lotus and jasmine soften the heart. Patchouli, vanilla and sugar make the base warm and sweet.

name: Morning Chess

name: Black II
desc: Plum and mandarin open fruity and bright, then rose, sandalwood and musk make a soft, floral heart. Vanilla and oakmoss give the base a creamy, mossy warmth.

name: London

name: New York
desc: Citrus, lavender and juniper open into geranium, iris and caramel, then deepen with vetiver, vanilla, amber and tobacco in a warm, sweet base.

name: Black Opium Intense

name: Black Opium Le Parfum
desc: Coffee and vanilla form a warm, sweet base beneath a veil of floral notes. Dark, cosy and gourmand, with a soft flowery glow.

name: Black Opium Pink Glaze
desc: Mandarin, strawberry and bergamot give a candied, bright start before jasmine and orange blossom. Amber, coffee, patchouli, vanilla and resins close it warm and sweet.

name: Kouros

name: Libre Berry Crush
desc: Juicy raspberry and creamy coconut meet orange blossom and lavender, resting on soft vanilla. Sweet and fruity, with a herbal thread running through.

name: Libre Eau de Toilette
desc: Bergamot, mandarin and lavender give a fresh, clear start. Orange blossom, jasmine and tea follow, finishing on a soft blend of musk, vanilla and ambergris.

name: Libre Intense
desc: Lavender and orange blossom open into jasmine sambac and orchid, then tonka bean, vanilla and ambergris with a dry vetiver edge. Creamy, floral and warm.

name: Libre Le Parfum
desc: Mandarin, ginger and saffron start bright and a little spicy. Bergamot, orange blossom and lavender follow, settling on honeyed vanilla and dry vetiver.

name: Libre Vanille Couture
desc: Blackcurrant, lavender and mandarin lead into a heart of jasmine and orange blossom. Vanilla, amber, cedarwood and musk give it a creamy, polished finish.

name: Mon Paris Intensément
desc: Juicy blackcurrant, raspberry and pear open the way to rose, peony and freesia. Musk, patchouli and benzoin keep it soft and slightly sweet.

name: Muse
desc: Iris, vanilla and black ink: powdery, sweet and faintly smoky. It wraps the skin in warmth with a dark, papery edge.

name: MYSLF Eau de Parfum
